caption: The image shows a round ceramic plate with a detailed illustration in the center surrounded by a broad decorative rim. The rim features a repeating floral and leaf pattern, which includes large flowers with visible petals and leaves, all rendered in shades of gray due to the black-and-white coloration of the photo. In the central scene, there is a large, multi-story building with a hipped roof, several chimneys, and a cupola. In front of the building, there are groups of people dressed in period clothing, some standing and others walking or conversing. A fence encloses the area around the building, with a path leading up to an entrance. In the background, additional smaller structures, a horse-drawn carriage, and grazing animals can be seen, while birds and clouds are depicted in the sky. The entire composition is framed within a scalloped edge inside the plate, separating the illustrated scene from the ornate border. The drawing is monochromatic, consisting of varying shades of gray to black.
title: Plate - "Nahant Hotel"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
